name: Partyline
overview: A Syncplay Chat fork adding private WebRTC voice to Jellyfin SyncPlay.
description: Keeps the original SyncPlay text chat and adds opt-in WebRTC mesh voice with authenticated signaling, adaptive audio, and optional coturn fallback.

versions.changelog: Initial independent Partyline release with persistent SyncPlay text chat, opt-in WebRTC voice, mobile controls, reconnect recovery, and private HTTPS setup guidance.
